question.problem:
Evaluate
${\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{\sqrt{z}}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{{e}^{z/x}}\text{d}y\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}z.$

*Hint: First change the order of integration to $\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}x.$*
question.worked_solution:
We wish to find the limits of integration such that our integral can be expressed as 

$$
{\int }_{a}^{b}{\int }_{{v}_{1}(x)}^{{v}_{2}(x)}{\int }_{{u}_{1}(x,z)}^{{u}_{2}(x,z)}\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}x.
$$

From the repeated integral, we see that the domain of integration $R$ can be written as a type III region as follows:

$$
R=\{(x,y,z)\,:\,0\le z\le 1,\,\,\sqrt{z}\le x\le 1,\,\,0\le y\le {e}^{z/x}\}
$$

Since all repeated integrals first integrate with respect to $y,$ the $y$-limits remain the same as before:

$$
{\int }_{a}^{b}{\int }_{{v}_{1}(x)}^{{v}_{2}(x)}{\int }_{0}^{{e}^{z/x}}\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}x
$$

 

Now, we consider the projection $D$ of $R$ onto the $xz$-plane shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14234808/assets/e83c249a6abf9710a201462e16c646a11411dbcdbca46f34e9beb8d2db7a654b.png)

The region $D$ is type II region in the $xz$-plane:

$$
D=\{(x,z)\,:\,0\le z\le 1,\,\sqrt{z}\le x\le 1\}.
$$

To change the order of integration from $\text{d}y\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}z$ to $\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}x,$ we write $D$ as a type I region.

Notice that the top boundary of the region $D,$ written in the form $z=z(x),$ is

$$
x=\sqrt{z}\,⟹\,z={x}^{2}
$$

and the bottom boundary of the region $D$ is

$$
z=0.
$$

Then, the type I representation of the region is

$$
D=\{(x,z)\,:\,0\le x\le 1,\,0\le z\le {x}^{2}\},
$$

as shown in the diagram below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14234808/assets/7e684766b85a214d1f1dd7845979052c532e11ecce74d0284b8fc379b5669957.png)

Therefore, by swapping the order of integration, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{\sqrt{z}}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{{e}^{z/x}}\text{d}y\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}z & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{{x}^{2}}{\int }_{0}^{{e}^{z/x}}\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{{x}^{2}}[{\int }_{0}^{{e}^{z/x}}\text{d}y]\text{d}z\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{{x}^{2}}[y]_{0}^{{e}^{z/x}}\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{{x}^{2}}{e}^{z/x}\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{{x}^{2}}{e}^{z/x}\,\text{d}z]\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[x{e}^{z/x}]_{z=0}^{z={x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(x{e}^{x}-x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={[(x-1){e}^{x}-\frac{1}{2}{x}^{2}]}_{0}^{1} \\  & =(0-\frac{1}{2})-(-1-0) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
